title: Cronos
description: A safe, timezone-aware cron expression parser for .NET.

data.text: Cronos is a safe, timezone-aware cron expression parser for .NET. Unlike other cron parsers, Cronos handles edge cases correctly and supports UTC and specific timezones.

data.title: Parsing and Evaluating Cron
data.content: Parse a cron expression and get occurrences.

terms.definition: A string representing a schedule in cron format (minute hour day month weekday).
Cronos correctly handles daylight saving time and timezone offsets.

data.title: Reliability
data.text: Cronos is more reliable than standard regex-based cron parsers for production scheduling.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Use Cronos when you need accurate, timezone-aware cron scheduling.
